sovereign_country.strategic_role: 苏伊士运河经济特区、辐射中东及北非的低成本轻工制造

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (Civil Law with Napoleonic tradition and Islamic Sharia as the principal source of legislation)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Egypt–United Kingdom Investment Agreement (1976, as updated under successive arrangements)
Agreement Establishing the African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA, 2019)
Egypt–Germany Bilateral Investment Treaty (1979, as amended)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law No. 80 of 2002 on Combating Money Laundering (as amended by Law No. 36 of 2014, Law No. 8 of 2015, and Law No. 22 of 2017); Cabinet Decree No. 582 of 2011 issuing the Executive Regulations of the AML Law; Companies Law No. 159 of 1981; Ministry of Investment Decree No. 51 of 2020 on Beneficial Ownership Data Registers for Companies

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the shareholder's jurisdiction of residence

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Corporate Registry Extract (for corporate shareholders)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies Registry or competent corporate registrar in the shareholder's home jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney for Pre-Incorporation Representation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the grantor's jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incumbency / Director List (for corporate shareholders or nominees)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Equity registry or corporate secretary in the jurisdiction of incorporation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter confirming source of funds
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Commercial bank in the client's or beneficial owner's jurisdiction

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, Egyptian Ministry of Interior terrorism list and Cabinet-designated terrorist entities, OFAC SDN list, and Egyptian Central Bank AML/CFT guidance issued under Law 80/2002. All shareholders and ultimate beneficial owners must be screened for Politically Exposed Persons (PEP) status, including family members and known close associates; any positive hit or elevated AML risk requires enhanced due diligence, source-of-funds documentation, and high-risk approval in accordance with Executive Regulation 582/2011, Articles 5 and 6.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) Integrated Company Registration Portal / Egyptian Commercial Registry
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company name must be reserved in Arabic. Any foreign-language or international name must be accompanied by an Arabic transliteration that meets commercial registry and grammatical acceptability standards. The Arabic name must not be misleading, blasphemous, or contrary to public order and good morals, and must accurately reflect the lawful corporate purpose.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Religious references (e.g., Islamic, Christian, Jewish) without prior ministerial consent
Investment in a manner implying licensed activity
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant may file a written grievance with the GAFI Grievance Committee within 30 business days of the rejection notice, attaching the original refusal notification and any corrective company name alternatives. If no administrative relief is granted, the applicant may initiate a challenge before the Egyptian Administrative Court within 60 days from the final administrative refusal. Legal counsel should be engaged to draft the grievance and, if needed, the administrative lawsuit to meet Egyptian Civil Procedures timings.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Conditionally acceptable for a low-risk POD custom apparel retail business. A serviced office, licensed co-working address, or registered agent with a physical address may satisfy the registered-office requirement, provided the address receives official correspondence and is capable of verifying operational substance. However, the Egyptian Tax Authority and labour inspectors may require a demonstrable physical nexus if VAT registration, payroll, or tax reporting obligations arise. The virtual office must not be a mere P.O. Box and should be capable of hosting limited inspection files.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low-to-moderate for a standard low-risk online retailer: approximately 5-10% annual probability of an unannounced inspection under normal compliance status. This probability increases to 15-20% upon tax filing inconsistencies, AML/PEP red flags, or a third-party complaint.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Law No. 159 of 1981, as amended (Chapter on Limited Liability Companies, Articles 102–119) and Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 (Articles 9–11, 15) for establishment through the General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) – Companies Registration Department, with downstream registration at the Commercial Registry of the Ministry of Trade and Industry.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Notarized Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association (Mowathaq Al-Ta'sis / Essamameh) filed with GAFI; Certificate of Incorporation (Shahadat Al-Tashbeeb) issued thereafter.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Under Companies Law No. 159/1981, LLC founders may fix the share capital in the Articles at any amount; there is no statutory minimum paid-up capital. Paid-up capital is evidenced by the notarized subscription schedule; no escrow account is mandatory. Cash contributions are credited to the corporate bank account after opening, while in-kind contributions are valued and described in the Articles.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: the directors approve the share subscription schedule whereby the founders subscribe for the entire share capital at par and pay contributions in cash or in-kind per the schedule; the registered office is hereby established at [address], and a notarized lease shall be filed with GAFI and the Commercial Registry; [Name] is appointed Chairperson, [Name] Managing Director, and [Name] Secretary for the first term; the Managing Director is authorized to execute registrations, tax filings, bank account opening, and signatory appointments; all prior incorporation acts are ratified. Effective immediately.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI One-Stop Shop online portal (gafi.gov.eg) in coordination with the Commercial Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log in to the GAFI 'Invest in Egypt' platform, select 'Establish a Limited Liability Company', submit three alternative trade names for the POD custom merchandise retail activity (ISIC 4791), and upload the founders' passports and power of attorney. For non-resident founders, legalize passports and POAs at an Egyptian consulate or through apostille. GAFI will issue a name clearance certificate against the Commercial Registry database.
required_dossiers: Copies of valid passports of all founders (legalized/apostilled where applicable)
Signed Power of Attorney (POA) for the authorized incorporator
Proof of residential address of the incorporator
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused because of similarity to a registered name, GAFI proceeds to the next alternative name on the submission; re-submission of a new list of three proposed names within 1 business day cures a total refusal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Notarization of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public Office of Cairo/Giza (Ministry of Justice) or GAFI-attached notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Arabic Memorandum and Articles of Association (with English translation if foreign partners execute) setting out the LLC name, registered office, corporate objects limited to retail sale of custom apparel through print-on-demand arrangements, share capital, profit-sharing, and managers/board of directors. All founders or authorized POA holders must sign before the Notary Public; the notary authenticates the document and returns certified copies for submission to GAFI.
required_dossiers: Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association
Power of Attorney for representatives (notarized and legalized)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Notary Public flags a deficiency in the corporate objects or capital clauses, amend the Articles by a supplementary draft signed by all founders; re-notarization within 2 business days cures the query.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: GAFI Incorporation Filing and Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) – Companies Registration Department, Dokki, Giza
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the notarized Memorandum and Articles, name clearance certificate, and incorporation forms with GAFI's online one-stop shop, pay the official incorporation and publication fees, and request the Certificate of Incorporation. GAFI screens the founders and allocates a company file number. If the founders opt for paid-up cash capital, include a bank proof of deposit; if not, proceed on the basis of the subscription schedule only.
required_dossiers: Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association (original and 2 copies)
National ID/passport copies of founders and managers
Bank certificate or statement confirming paid-up contributions, if applicable
Registration and publication fee payment receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If GAFI asks for clarification on the business scope or the absence of minimum capital, provide an amending resolution of the founders and an updated activity description conforming to ISIC 4791; resubmission through the same file within 3 days cures the suspension.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial Registry Department, Ministry of Trade and Industry (local governorate Commercial Registry office)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the incorporated LLC in the Commercial Registry by filing the Certificate of Incorporation, approved Articles, notarized lease of the registered office, manager IDs, and proof of rent. The registry enters the entity in the national Sijill Tijari and issues the Commercial Registry Extract, which is the operative evidence of legal standing required for e-commerce payment gateways.
required_dossiers: Notarized lease agreement of the registered office
Manager IDs and proof of residency
GAFI file number and company seal
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Commercial Registry queries the lease validity or manager domicile, notarize a supplementary lease commitment or appoint a resident manager; re-registration is completed within 2 days upon correction.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration: Tax Card, VAT, and E-Invoicing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) – head office and branch window; online portal efin.eta.gov.eg
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the incorporation and Commercial Registry documents to ETA for issuance of the Tax Identification Number (TIN) and Tax Card (Bitaqat Al-Tadakhala). Register for VAT under the VAT Law No. 67/2016 when taxable turnover exceeds the statutory threshold; register as a withholding agent for salary tax and corporate tax. Enroll on the ETA e-invoicing platform after receiving the TIN and obtain the tax registration certificate.
required_dossiers: Bank account details or bank statement (if opened)
Manager ID and Power of Attorney
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If ETA delays the Tax Card due to data mismatch between GAFI and the Commercial Registry, request reconciliation from both registries and apply for a temporary tax status certificate in writing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Bank Account Opening and Filing of First Board Resolution
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Central Bank of Egypt licensed commercial banks (e.g., National Bank of Egypt, Banque Misr)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open the LLC's corporate bank account by presenting the Certificate of Incorporation, Commercial Registry extract, Tax Card, the First Board Resolution appointing signatories, and passport copies of directors and beneficial owners. Complete CBE-mandated KYC on beneficial owners holding 25% or more. If cash capital was fixed, deposit the paid-up amount and obtain a deposit certificate. File the First Board Resolution in the corporate minute book and issue share subscription certificates to the founders.
required_dossiers: Passport copies and POAs of directors/beneficial owners
Business plan or sample invoices to support the POD retail business purpose
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If KYC is questioned due to non-resident ownership, submit a corporate ownership chart, source-of-funds declaration, and legalized passports; proceed with a second bank offering non-resident onboarding if the first bank declines.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable for retail-only POD custom apparel. If future in-house printing or light manufacturing is introduced, the Industrial Development Authority (IDA) under Law No. 15/2017 would be the competent board for an industrial license.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No statutory industry-specific license required for this ISIC. The Commercial Registry Certificate (Sijill Tijari) and tax registration constitute the operating authorization for the e-commerce POD retail business.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Egyptian Environmental Affairs Agency (EEAA), Ministry of Environment
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Not triggered for retail-only POD. If on-site digital sublimation or DTF printing is added, the activity will typically fall under Category C (registration only) at small scale, and may require Category B (limited EIA Report) above the scale thresholds set under Law No. 4/1994, as amended.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: For any future in-house printing: industrial wastewater discharges to public sewer must comply with the effluent limits established under Law No. 4/1994 and its executive regulations; volatile organic compound (VOC) and particulate emissions from printing/drying must meet EEAA ambient air and workplace exposure limits; waste inks, spent DTF films, and contaminated consumables must be handled as waste regulated by EEAA and transferred through approved waste management contractors. Retail-only warehouse operations are subject to municipal solid waste segregation and disposal rules.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Civil Defense Fire Safety Clearance from the Civil Defense Authority (Ministry of Interior) is required for the office/warehouse premises before operations begin. A structural inspection certificate for light racking and storage loads is recommended, and an occupational safety clearance from the Ministry of Manpower is required to cover workplace conditions, first aid, and employee accident insurance under the Social Insurance Law No. 148/2019.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA), Ministry of Finance – official portal: https://www.eta.gov.eg/
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A non-resident LLC must apply to the ETA via the tax portal to obtain a Tax Identification Number (TIN) by filing the Tax Card application. Required documents include certified constitutional documents, commercial register extract, proof of Egypt address/lease, power of attorney to a local tax representative, and foreign entity registration certificates. VAT registration is made separately under Law 67/2016, either voluntarily or mandatorily within 30 days of exceeding the EGP 500,000 annual taxable turnover threshold; the ETA issues a VAT certificate linked to the TIN.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Not applicable. Egypt does not offer U.S.-style check-the-box elections; LLCs are treated as separate taxable entities under Egyptian law. No general hybrid mismatch election exists, although limited thin-capitalization and treaty-based tie-breaker rules apply.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) – Law No. 67 of 2016
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EGP 500,000 in annual taxable turnover (mandatory registration threshold; voluntary registration is permitted for lower turnover)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Egypt operates a mandatory e-invoicing regime for phased-in taxable persons. Qualified taxpayers must integrate their ERP systems with the ETA e-invoice platform via API and issue QR-coded invoices that pass real-time validation before use. A parallel mandatory e-receipt system applies to retail business-to-consumer transactions. For an online POD retailer, every export sale must be reported digitally to the ETA; failure to obtain a valid UUID/QR code may block registration and result in administrative penalties.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Export of goods physically leaving Egypt, including POD custom apparel, is subject to 0% VAT when the exporter holds an official customs export declaration and the sales proceeds are received in an acceptable foreign currency. Direct services associated with exported goods may also qualify if performed abroad and consumed by a non-resident. The taxpayer must retain contracts, customs declarations, shipping documents, and bank evidence proving the foreign trade and movement.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Unsubstantiated export zero-rating is retroactively reversed, converting the supply to taxable at 14% VAT, with late-payment charges and fines of up to EGP 50,000 per invoice/document. Fraudulent documentation or failure to repatriate export proceeds within 180 days may trigger criminal penalties under Law No. 207/2020 on Tax Evasion and the Unified Customs Law, including imprisonment, confiscation, and suspension of the exporter's tax registration.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Egypt (CBE) - Foreign Exchange Operations Sector
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Egypt observes IMF Article VIII current-account convertibility for trade in goods, services, and profit remittances, yet capital-account convertibility remains administratively restricted. Inward and outward capital movements, including LLC equity injections and dividend distributions, must be channelled through CBE-authorized dealer banks, with documented underlying investment, audited financial statements, and tax clearance. Since the October 2024 flexible exchange-rate reform, the CBE no longer publishes a rigid official parity; USD/EGP pricing is determined in an interbank market operated under CBE oversight with managed-float characteristics. Profit remittance is permissible but subject to bank-level documentary review and the availability of foreign currency in the banking system.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Export proceeds must be repatriated into an Egyptian licensed bank within 180 days from the date of shipment unless CBE agrees otherwise. The exporter may retain the foreign currency in a retention account or convert to EGP at the prevailing interbank rate. The mandatory conversion ratio is currently nil under the CBE's export-support and FX-liberalization circulars; however, the CBE reserves the right to impose a surrender ratio or temporary retention rules during balance-of-payments stress or emergency exchange-control measures.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium when used as a supplementary collection/disbursement rail; Low when proposed as the primary treasury settlement account. Offshore digital electronic-money institutions (EMIs) such as Wise, Payoneer, or similar platforms may support card collection and international payouts, but the principal corporate account and FX treasury must reside at a CBE-licensed bank. The Egyptian payment-services regulatory framework under Law No. 18 of 2019 prohibits unlicensed non-bank entities from carrying out e-money issuance or payment-system activities in Egypt; therefore, using an offshore EMI for primary settlement would be legally constrained and inadvisable. A bank-integrated payment-orchestration model is the compliant structure.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: A physical presence requirement is effectively mandatory for final account activation at Egyptian tier-1 banks. At least one director or authorised officer must attend an in-person KYC interview in Egypt, and the entity must maintain a registered operational address evidenced by lease or ownership documents. The CBE anti-money-laundering framework, founded on the Money Laundering Combating Law No. 80 of 2002 and CBE AML regulations, requires identification of ultimate beneficial owners (UBOs) and does not currently grant a general statutory right to fully remote corporate onboarding, especially for non-resident-owned LLCs. Preliminary remote due-diligence is possible, but the bank will require a physical visit before issuance of payment credentials.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: POD/e-commerce transaction profile consisting of high-frequency, low-value card payments routed from global marketplaces without physical inventory inspection
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed POD platform agreements (Stripe, PayPal, Shopify or equivalent), merchant-ID verification, customer invoices and payment logs, supplier purchase orders, fulfilment-centre contracts, product-description catalogue, and at least six months of raw settlement statements showing genuine end-customer sales.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident shareholders and directors with an apparently fragmented or shell-like operational nexus
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Egyptian commercial registry extract, tax registration card, lease agreement for an active operational premises, UBO register, board resolutions authorising local bank signatories and cash-flow control, employment contracts for a resident manager, and evidence that books and records are physically maintained in Egypt.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border counterparties or payors from sanctioned, high-risk, or tax-haven jurisdictions inconsistent with the stated POD business model
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Transactional trail linking each relevant payment to an identifiable customer and order, IP-geolocation and device-fingerprint logs, customer due-diligence scoring outputs, standard terms of sale, an OFAC/UN/EU/CBE sanctions-compliance policy, and written narrative explanation for any payments originating from adverse-risk jurisdictions.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The compliant route is a SWIFT MT103 transfer from the non-resident investor's bank to the Egyptian LLC's capital-cum-operational account held at a CBE-authorized dealer bank. The wire instruction must clearly state the underlying purpose as 'Foreign Direct Investment / equity subscription in an Egyptian LLC' and include the LLC's commercial registration number. The receiving bank will require the Investment Law certificate or economic-licence evidence, board and shareholders' resolutions approving the capital injection, constitutional documents, and completion of the CBE's inward foreign investment reporting form. Conversion into EGP, if desired, is executed at the interbank market rate announced by the CBE on the value date.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For low-value POD raw-material or service payments, SWIFT MT103 documentary remittance is the standard clearing rail, with invoices and purchase orders submitted through Egyptian bank channels as a current-account transfer. For large or bulk apparel procurement, a UCP600-compliant commercial documentary letter of credit issued by an Egyptian licensed bank and advised or confirmed by a foreign correspondent bank is recommended. Settlement is cleared over the SWIFT network and the Egyptian interbank foreign-exchange clearing system. Following the CBE's post-2024 foreign-exchange reforms, outbound trade disbursements no longer require CBE pre-approval or the former import-finance registration protocols, provided the transfer is supported by genuine trade documentation and the account has a compliant source of foreign currency.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Interbank deliverable forward EGP/USD contracts, typically available to Egyptian onshore corporate entities through authorized-dealer banks
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) in EGP/USD contracted with international counterparties, used where onshore liquidity or bank limits do not support physical delivery
Cross-currency swaps between EGP and USD matched to the underlying trade-finance or capital-injection exposure
Option strategies on tracked non-deliverable forwards to cap the EGP cost of projected cross-border settlements, subject to bank treasury credit approval

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Financial Statements (audited or unaudited as applicable) and corporate declaration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months of the fiscal year-end (calendar year for most LLCs)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing fines up to EGP 100,000; repeated non-filing for two consecutive years exposes the LLC to administrative strike-off from the Commercial Registry and legal dissolution.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 30 April following the calendar year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Monthly late-payment penalty of 5% of unpaid tax, capped at 25% of the total tax due; additional penal provisions under Egyptian Tax Law No. 91/2005 and prolonged delay may trigger tax avoidance prosecution.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Commercial Register Renewal / License Fee Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Commercial Registry — Ministry of Trade and Industry of Egypt
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 31 March (or anniversary of initial registration based on register district practice)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative strike-off from the Commercial Register renders the LLC unable to conduct legal operations; reinstatement requires clearance and penalty fee of up to EGP 5,000.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial Ownership Annual Confirmation and Register Update
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Authority for Investment (GAFI) — Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO) Register
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Simultaneously with the annual financial statements filing (within 6 months of fiscal year-end)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: GAFI may impose fines of up to EGP 50,000 and suspend the entity’s commercial registration access for non-confirmation or materially false UBO declarations.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: An Egyptian LLC is legally required to appoint a certified external statutory auditor if it exceeds any two of the three thresholds set forth in the Egyptian Companies Law No. 194/2020 (total annual revenue exceeding EGP 50 million; total assets exceeding EGP 20 million; average annual employees exceeding 50). If an LLC does not meet these thresholds, an independent audit is still mandatory when required by creditors, investors, or by the ETA for tax audit verification.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Egyptian Accounting Standards (EAS), which are nearly fully converged with IFRS; financial statements are prepared in Egyptian Pounds for all statutory reporting and tax compliance purposes.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Every Egyptian LLC is required to maintain a current UBO register and to file through GAFI an annual beneficial ownership confirmation naming all individuals who directly or indirectly control 25% or more of the company. Any shareholding transfer that alters beneficial ownership must be reported to the UBO Register within 15 days of the transfer and is also reflected in the subsequent annual confirmation.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 350 – USD 1,200 annual registered office/agent service fee in Cairo and major governorates
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 800 – USD 2,500 for a small-to-mid-size LLC engaging a licensed Egyptian audit firm for a standard non-complex POD retail trade
